note: Beaverhead-Deerlodge NF (Butte Ranger District) campground in the Boulder River drainage, beside the Boulder River (fishing); more dispersed camping just east. From Butte about 18 mi north on I-15 to exit 151 (Bernice), then about 13 mi west on Boulder River Road (FSR 82), a county-maintained gravel road the Forest Service calls suitable for passenger vehicles and trailers. Continental Divide Trail trailheads within 5 mi. --Claude
